source_caption: Breaking Bad (2008–2013) is a legendary crime drama starring Bryan Cranston as Walter White, a struggling chemistry teacher who turns to making drugs after a life-changing diagnosis. Teaming up with his former student Jesse Pinkman, played by Aaron Paul, he slowly transforms into the ruthless kingpin “Heisenberg.” Known for its intense storytelling, character evolution, and moral complexity, the show is widely regarded as one of the greatest TV series ever made.

source_details.title: Breaking Bad
source_details.synopsis: Breaking Bad is an American neo-Western crime drama television series created by Vince Gilligan for AMC. Set and filmed in Albuquerque, New Mexico, the series follows Walter White (Bryan Cranston), an overqualified high school chemistry teacher who, after being diagnosed with stage-three lung cancer, begins producing and selling methamphetamine with former student Jesse Pinkman (Aaron Paul) to secure his family's financial future. The series also stars Anna Gunn, Dean Norris, Betsy Brandt, RJ Mitte, Giancarlo Esposito, Bob Odenkirk, and Jonathan Banks.
